modules.module_title: Introduction to the Role of Waste Picker

pcs.pc_description: Explain why waste collection is important for a clean environment, good health and earning a livelihood.
Describe the role and main duties of a Waste Picker.
Explain the importance of discipline, punctuality, honesty and good behaviour at work.
Identify simple communication skills needed to talk politely with households, supervisors, and team members
Explain basic points of the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016 and latest amendments that a Waste Picker must follow.
Explain what the NAMASTE Scheme is and why it is implemented for sanitation and waste workers
Describe the basic steps of municipal solid waste management such as waste generation, collection, transport, and disposal
Explain the importance of equal participation of women and men in waste collection work.
Describe simple examples of organised waste collection models from cities like Pune (SWaCH) and Bengaluru (Hasiru Dala).
Show polite and respectful behaviour while collecting waste from households
Speak clearly and politely with households during door-to-door waste collection.
Work together with team members during waste collection activities
Follow instructions given by the supervisor during daily work
Take part in a simple group presentation on a successful waste collection model from a city.
Share key learnings from stories of organised waste collection models like SWaCH–Pune and Hasiru Dala–Bengaluru
Use pictures, charts or videos to identify benefits and support services under the NAMASTE Scheme.

Explain basic source-level segregation principles.

Explain selection and purpose of PPE for waste identification and collection
Explain signs and symbols related to waste segregation and storage.
Demonstrate different categories of waste from mixed samples
Segregate reusable, recyclable, non- recyclable and hazardous waste correctly.
Use basic tools such as sticks and magnets for safe waste picking
Demonstrate the Do’s and Don’ts of waste handling
Demonstrate how to prepare the equipment used for waste collection
Show to read Signs and Symbols used for waste collection
Demonstrate proper handling of Recyclable waste

Demonstrate how to collect segregated waste from households following route plans
